Fraser Place Roppongi, Tokyo is a welcoming haven for every traveller who seeks more than just a place to stay. View details Fraser Residence Putrajaya Fraser Residence Putrajaya offers contemporary serviced residences set against the calming waters of Putrajaya Lake — perfectly positioned between Putrajaya and Cyberjaya, just 20 minutes from KLIA and Kuala Lumpur. Designed for business travellers, project teams and relocating families, our spacious serviced apartments combine the privacy of home with the ease of hotel services. View details Fraser Residence Wuzhen Just 2.4km away from the famous Wuzhen water town in Jiaxing and minutes from the World Internet Conference Venue, Fraser Residence Wuzhen is a modern serviced residence offering the comfort of apartments with services of a hotel, providing a tranquil base for both short-term and long-stay travellers. View details Capri by Fraser, Penang / Malaysia Discover a fresh take on urban living at Capri by Fraser, Penang / Malaysia, where style, technology, and social spaces come together for the modern traveller. Located in Magazine Road, just moments from the UNESCO-listed George Town, our pet-friendly 22-storey hotel residence puts you at the crossroads of history, culture, and contemporary convenience. Whether you’re here for business, leisure, or a long-term stay, you’ll find yourself immersed in Penang’s unique charm with iconic street art, cultural hotspots, and bustling markets at your doorstep. View details Modena by Fraser Wujiaochang Shanghai Modena by Fraser Wujiaochang Shanghai is located in the core area of Yangpu District. It is adjacent to the Wujiaochang business district and multiple metro lines, serving as an urban residence that combines convenience and premium living. Surrounded by global tech giants, upscale shopping complexes, and prestigious institutions like Fudan University and Tongji University. View details Heartland Serviced Apartments Heartland Serviced Apartments is conveniently situated in the heart of Hankou’s business district on Jinghan Avenue. Seamlessly connected to Heartland 66, a world-class landmark in Wuhan, our residences are surrounded by vibrant commercial amenities, lush parks, convenient medical services and top-tier educational establishments. View details FRASER DIFFERENCE At Frasers Hospitality, the difference lies in the way we care. Underlying our award-winning service is an innate sense of empathy, and a strong intuition for what our guests need. With our attention to detail coupled with the comfort and luxury of our properties, we deliver a memorable experience which our guests keep coming back for. AWARD-WINNING SERVICES We are always there for you, whatever the hour, whatever the task. Leave it to us to make you feel at home, with all of the comforts you expect, and hospitality you won’t forget. GLOBAL FOOTPRINT With over 100 properties in more than 20 countries across Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, we welcome travellers seeking exciting business opportunities and amazing travel experiences. THE LUXURY OF SPACE Our properties are designed for comfort and style, in spacious layouts that provide all the room you need to live, work and play. FRASER CARES We believe in kindness and caring for the community. We seek out and celebrate individuals, whether in our properties or around us, who remind us of our humanity and the need to do good for the world. CUTTING EDGE Frasers Hospitality is at the forefront of innovation, harnessing the latest in hotel technology to enhance the guest experience with high connectivity and smart lifestyle solutions. WELLNESS We have your physical and mental wellbeing in mind, with a host of sports facilities to keep you fit and recharged, and tranquil retreats to ease the stress of modern city life. SUSTAINABILITY We are committed to preserving the environment with a long term vision to conserve energy and water, replacing single-use plastics and developing sustainable buildings of the future.
